variants.prompt:
Create ONE square harbor terrain tile, matching references' dense tiny hand-pixelled old-school 2D fantasy strategy style. Reference 1 is the harbor layout/style reference; reference2 is original town drawing style; reference3 is the exact ocean color/wave style. Major required change from reference1: distinctly TEAL/TURQUOISE BLUE tiled roofs and PALE LIGHT GRAY stone cottages, NOT red roofs or brown half-timber town houses. Three compact cottages, grassy/cobblestone land, short wooden dock, exactly one small wooden moored boat with off-white sail in the OPEN WATER sector. Fixed elevated oblique view and upper-left illumination for all variants: buildings and boat remain upright and in the SAME camera perspective; do NOT rotate the whole picture. Each direction is a re-composed shore layout, not a rotated image. Square opaque tile fills frame, no drawn hex border/pedestal/sky/text. Intended final size140x140, so chunky crisp forms and readable pixels. Will be clipped to pointy-top hex with vertices (50%,0),(93%,25%),(93%,75%),(50%,100%),(7%,75%),(7%,25%): dock, boat and buildings must fit INSIDE this hex safe area, not at corners. Ocean deep blue with thin pale wave pattern, vegetation like original assets. Keep approx same three houses, dock and boat scale across the set. No glossy 3D, photorealism, vector, gradients, elaborate towers or people.
DIRECTION SPEC: EAST: land mass occupies left two-thirds, open sea on RIGHT side. Dock extends rightward; moored boat in the right open water, centered at about (78%,50%), entirely within safe hex.
